name: Arcade Machine
summary: Upright arcade cabinet with a screen, joystick and buttons; use for arcade, gaming hall or retro game scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cabinet base rests on y; room scale, about 1000 px tall at s = 1 (keep y near 1600 so it fits)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; room scale, about 1000 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.6 to fit beside a person

params.name: anim
params.note: attract = blocks move on the screen and the marquee lights pulse
